resources.string: Your Launch Pad, Category Cruise & Cockpit overlays, per-app window detection (100% offline)

Lightspeed uses Accessibility only on your device to show its overlays (Your Launch Pad, Category Cruise and Cockpit) over other apps and to know which app is in front:

• Gestures & Navigation: Runs Back, Home, Recents, Split Screen, and your custom swipes.
• Which App Is In Front: Detects the current app and window to apply your per-app refresh rate, orientation, cutout and App Airlock, and to hide overlays on the lock screen. It never reads passwords, chats, or screen text.
• Optional Hardware Keys: Intercepts Volume/Power shortcuts only when you turn those gestures on.
• Local Screenshot & Beacons: Captures local screenshots when you trigger Screen Grabber or Screenshot Blur, and mirrors opt-in transient alerts on Beacons.

Privacy Guarantee: Lightspeed has ZERO internet or network permissions. Nothing is ever collected, logged, or uploaded.

Android 13+ Switch Greyed Out? Open App Info, tap the three dots (⋮) in the corner, then choose Allow restricted settings.

What Lightspeed uses Accessibility for (100% on-device):

• Edge Pill & Overlays: Shows Your Launch Pad (the edge pill), Category Cruise, Cockpit, and Airlock overlays over other apps.
• Navigation & Gestures: Performs Back, Home, Recents, Split Screen, Quick Settings, and custom swipe gestures.
• Per-App Window Detection & Lock Safety: Checks which app is in front to switch refresh rate (Hz), orientation, display cutout, App Airlock, and auto-hide on the lock screen. Lightspeed never reads typed text, passwords, or personal content.
• Optional Key Shortcuts: Listens for Volume or Power shortcuts only when you enable them.
• Screen Capture & Beacons: Takes local screenshots strictly when you trigger Screen Grabber or Screenshot Blur, and drives opt-in notification Beacons.

100% Offline Privacy Guarantee: Lightspeed declares zero internet or network permissions. No data ever leaves your device.

Lightspeed is a meta-launcher & Android control layer built on Linux\'s open foundation — keep your current home screen launcher and OEM features while commanding apps, gestures, and system controls from anywhere.

The Astrogation Core — or the edge pill on the right (or left) side of your screen — is the first thing you see when Lightspeed is active. From here, you reach all three workstations without leaving any app or video:
Rest your finger or slide up and down on the Astrogation Core pill to open Category Cruise — and experience one-thumb cruising through your categorized app drawers over any screen or video.
Slide your finger horizontally from the pill to open Cockpit — your favorite apps arranged in Cockpit Gear Sets inside Cockpit Hangar\'s spinning dial customizer.
Your Android control layer & main settings. Open from the Lightspeed icon, or swipe down past the bottom Category Cruise category until you feel strong haptic feedback.

The 3-position selector acts as a non-destructive Flight Profile Switch:
• CLONE LEFT: Left Wing is master. Right Wing automatically mirrors its geometry or inverts and executes its gestures.
• INDEPENDENT: Bilateral multi-role setup. Both wings have dedicated, independent gesture maps and dimensions.
• CLONE RIGHT: Right Wing is master. Left Wing automatically mirrors its geometry or opens the Cockpit / executes its gestures.
Switching profiles never deletes your custom setups. Switching back to INDEPENDENT restores all unique mappings instantly.

• Independent Geometry: Top and bottom wing spans, reaches, and glows remain independently tunable for natural grip comfort.

• Action Independence: Actions from the Action Selection Menu operate completely independently from this toggle, acting as transient manual overrides that yield automatically back upon switching apps or screen-off. Lightspeed is built out of deep appreciation for the independent Android modding, FOSS, and power-user community. Every line of Kotlin and Jetpack Compose is original clean-room work by SBF Labs, shaped by respect for these pioneers:

• Recents (by tymwitko) — Conceptual inspiration for the launcher-agnostic workspace allowing Lightspeed to act as a daily launcher alongside your system home (clean-room implementation).\n• LaunchTime — Conceptual inspiration for the structured, auto-categorized app drawer layout (clean-room implementation).

• Droid Labs — Direct inspiration for media playback tracking and live download progress indicators in the HUD strip.
• Fluid Navigation Gestures, Edge Gestures & One Hand Control — Inspiration for simple, two-step, rebound, and hold edge maneuvers.
• Key Mapper, MacroDroid, Shortcut Maker, SystemUI Tuner & Tap, Tap — Direct inspiration for Hull & Ship Maneuvers, System Overrides, and the Action Selection Menu.
• Volume++ & 32steps — Direct inspiration for Sonic Deck and granular audio stream controls.

• Shizuku+ & Hari Prabhu (@hariprabhu1008) — Seeing builders refine independent Android utilities out in the open gave the blueprint and confidence to ship Lightspeed publicly.\n• InviZible Pro, MiXplorer, Obtainium & ObtainX, Shizuku / Shevery / Stellar — Cornerstones proving Android tools can stay extraordinarily powerful, privacy-respecting, and free of store lock-in.

Thick glass screen protectors or heavy-duty cases often shade or reflect light away from the ambient lux sensor, causing Android auto-brightness to think the room is darker than it is and underexpose your screen. This offset shifts the baseline brightness up (+1%..+20%) or down to keep auto-curves perfectly legible without disabling adaptive mode.

Brightness Override locks screen luminance using a top-level overlay so media players (VLC, MX Player, YouTube) or system ambient sensors cannot hijack or dim your display. Trigger it anytime by scrubbing upward past 100%. When automation is turned on, the system automatically disengages the override and restores your adaptive curve on the triggers selected below.
